overview: After 1.Nc3 d5 2.e4 c6 3.h3 White stops ...Bg4 and prepares quiet development with Nf3 and d4 against the Caro-Kann set-up. Black keeps the usual Caro-Kann structure and plays ...e6 or ...dxe4. The result is a solid, manoeuvring game with small differences from normal Caro-Kann lines.

white_ideas.idea: Exchange or advance in the centre with e5

typical_structures.structure: Caro-Kann pawn structure with the half-open c- or d-file

character.notes: The Caro-Kann structure is hard to break down.

soundness.notes: Sound; h3 is a slow move.

structure.notes: Caro-Kann centre with exchanges on e4 or d5 leaves a half-open file.

approach.notes: A rare sideline that strong players seldom use.
